existing_authoring_validator_boundary: portable Item authoring structure and declared dependency closure; no runtime qualification

real_example_closed_scope.warning: These checks apply to retained real-example fixture contract, not automatic current full-pool readiness counts

checklist.check: Unique exact current numeric binding and target identity; preserve own-ID-first and all-present source agreement; separate portable Item versus Terrain/WorldObject/instance state. Qualified family/navigation metadata alone is not native admission.

identity, display_name, family_profile, delivery_task_eligible, taxonomy present; taxonomy item_class and primary present. Validate family/item_class using taxonomy88ed constraint only after real composition; native4f schema alone does not impose it.

Pinned source identities and real capture timestamps; every source field occurrence has exactly one disposition, and dispositions equal complete field_inventory. No unsupported_source_field, unresolved_semantics or conflict may pass import-readiness. Missing source field remains UNKNOWN; absence is not FALSE/N/A.

Destination exists with admitted unit/type/exact value and accepted owner (native semantics or ItemAuthoring), all applicable guards and known/conflict-state preservation. Rational percentage points, relative p/100, milliseconds and source units stay distinct. OTS hypotheses remain labeled hypotheses; engine agreement does not become official truth.

Apply exact nested required/oneOf/anyOf constraints and semantic coherence; missing common capabilities produce warning, not failure. Equipment slot/hands/reservation, damage minimum<=maximum, resource/vector uniqueness, imbuement exclusion, lifecycle decay consistency. No generic all-optional-known rule.

Resolve every exact used definition/asset/proficiency crosswalk to its owning domain; no duplicate or unused declarations. Quest/drop/trade/actor/effect/formula/FX/audio relations retain source owning disposition; identity of a sound/effect alone does not establish its activation/consumer binding.

checklist.scope: when presentation/assets declared or source routes demand them
checklist.check: appearance_binding requires actual pinned presentation payload and valid frame geometry/sprite counts. Sprite-atlas absence is a warning in structural validator, a real-example blocker, and must remain explicit in any renderability claim. Do not infer zero/missing FX from no source binding.

field_evidence and non_source_defaults exactly partition authored leaves (validator-specific exceptions preserved). Defaults/normalizations are labeled, not source-proven. Existing validate_real_example is a closed real-example contract, not evidence that all34031 rows were checked.

Exact final published parent/source/packet SHA, actual typed owner equality, deterministic native/tree/migration comparison, preservation of unrelated fields, approved dependencies. Overlay taxonomy/world/native reports are not proof that their branches were integrated.

Existing Item authoring CLI always reports runtime_qualified=false. Rune ability/formula, modifier target/evaluation/priority, interaction/effects, sprites/resources and actor rules need their actual accepted owning contracts; do not substitute source metadata completion for runtime readiness.

source_fields.disposition: mapped / accepted external or omission / conflict or unresolved
source_fields.typed_owner: actual native path / authoring / external owning relation
source_fields.blocker: exact missing mapping/unit/identity/source/owner reason or null

capabilities.name: authored or independently source-applicable group
capabilities.required_by: actual schema conditional or actual source route; never common list alone

relations.binding_status: resolved / held / unsupported / no observed fact

proposed_per_item_record_shape.source_import_complete: null until G1-G9 evaluated for declared scope and proposed aggregate gate accepted
proposed_per_item_record_shape.runtime_qualified: null until actual owning runtime contract checked

definition_of_done.categorized: Exact accepted family metadata and domain disposition established; not native playable admission
definition_of_done.source_coverage_complete: Every retained field in explicitly pinned source scope has one supported disposition; external relation omission is explicit, not lost
definition_of_done.typed_import_complete: Every accepted applicable intrinsic source mapping exists at actual stored typed owner with exact value; all conditional authoring and declared dependency constraints pass; no unresolved applicable source fact within declared scope
definition_of_done.runtime_qualified: Separate owning runtime contract; NOT_ESTABLISHED globally by current Item authoring validator
definition_of_done.all_zero_claim: Only after every scoped Item has evaluated gate records with no open applicable source/import/relationship blocker; cannot infer from zero missing templates or successful batch counts

validation_performed: Read-only byte/digest/code/schema/catalog consistency audit; no Cargo, whole-pool validator or project mutation
